metadata.name: RouteAroundBench
metadata.paraphrase_note: Paraphrase materialization rewrites task goal wording only; states, policies, tool schemas, canonical actions, oracles, and seeds are held fixed. The 0.25 fraction yields 30 unsafe and 15 benign paraphrase scenarios per model, matching the paired prompt-robustness subset.
metadata.construction: 3 domains x 4 route families x 10 unsafe variants plus 3 domains x 4 route families x 5 benign variants
metadata.execution_boundary: deterministic in-memory simulator with no external side effects
